To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel direct numerical integration method for the calculation of infinite integrals is presented.
the new integration scheme is more accurate than the approximations used in other works and that the accuracy of the results is not affected by the frequency or the earth resistivity.

(a) the earth return path of underground cables influences significantly their transient impedances, especially at high frequency, (b) the novel integration scheme is numerically stable and accurate in all cases examined and (c) the earth return paths of underground power cables should be modeled accurately in transient simulations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel direct numerical integration method for the calculation of earth return path impedance terms of underground power cables.
the development of a novel method for the direct calculation of earth return path impedance terms of underground power cables.
the development of a new direct numerical integration scheme to calculate the impedance of the earth return path for the case of single-core cables.

for a single-core configuration, the novel integration scheme provides accurate results in all cases examined and that the finite-element method is the best approach to be used in the case of multiconductor configurations, although the computational cost is high.

the new method can be used with confidence in all cases of interest.

the direct numerical integration scheme presented in this paper is a reliable and accurate method for the evaluation of underground cable impedances.
